department: Department of Process Engineering and Applied Science

deadline.value: Apply by April 1, 2027 (the Faculty of Graduate Studies deadline for non-Canadian applicants for September entry; the department sets no earlier date).
deadline.quote: For September admission: | June 1 (Canadian applicants), April 1 (non-Canadian applicants)

also.quote: Many departments have their own deadlines, which can be much earlier than the above deadlines.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: A professor must accept you into their research program.
supervisor.quote: To be admitted to the MASc or PhD programs, an applicant must be accepted by a professor into his/her research program in addition to meeting the other requirements for admission.

funding.value: Not stated on the department's pages.

entry_route.value: With a research master's the PhD needs 4 courses; without one, 8 courses.
entry_route.quote: The PhD Degree requires 4 courses if a candidate already has a research Master’s degree; otherwise, it requires 8 courses.

english_waiver.value: The department exempts a bachelor's from a recognized institution taught in English, subject to FGS verification.
english_waiver.quote: Possession of a baccalaureate degree or its academic equivalent from an academic institution recognized by Dalhousie University, in which the language of instruction is English

notes: Department page quotes TOEFL on the old paper scale (580); the FGS iBT minimum applies.
name: Chemical Engineering (PhD)
